item.description:

item.title: SQL Injection
item.description:
By: Prasanna | November 26, 2026

A curated collection of resources to learn and practice SQL Injection, covering fundamentals, advanced exploitation techniques, cheat sheets, hands-on labs, and real-world bug bounty writeups.

1. Introduction to SQL Injection

Start with the fundamentals of SQL Injection and understand how vulnerabilities occur in web applications.

Resource Description
What is SQL Injection? - PortSwigger Introduction to SQL Injection, attack techniques, and vulnerabilities.
Advanced SQL Injection - YouTube Advanced SQL Injection presentation by Joseph McCray (DEFCON 17).

2. SQL Injection Cheat Sheets

Useful references for understanding SQL syntax, database-specific payloads, and different SQL Injection techniques.

# Resource Description
1 PortSwigger SQL Injection Cheat Sheet Database-specific SQL Injection syntax and techniques.
2 Advanced SQL Injection Cheatsheet Advanced SQL Injection techniques and payload references.
3 PayloadsAllTheThings - SQL Injection Collection of SQL Injection payloads and exploitation techniques.
4 HackTricks - SQL Injection Practical SQL Injection methodology and exploitation references.

3. Hands-on SQL Injection Labs

Practice SQL Injection techniques in intentionally vulnerable environments.

3.1 TryHackMe

# Lab Description
1 SQL Injection Lab Hands-on SQL Injection practice.
2 SQL Injection Practical SQL Injection exercises.

3.2 PortSwigger Web Security Academy

Basic SQL Injection

# Lab Description
1 SQL Injection - Retrieve Hidden Data Retrieve hidden records by exploiting SQL Injection.
2 SQL Injection - Login Bypass Bypass authentication using SQL Injection.

UNION-Based SQL Injection

# Lab Description
3 Determine the Number of Columns Determine the number of columns returned by the original query.
4 Find a Column Containing Text Identify a column compatible with string data.
5 Retrieve Data from Other Tables Retrieve data from other database tables.
6 Retrieve Multiple Values in a Single Column Combine multiple values into a single returned column.

Examining the Database

# Lab Description
7 Querying Database Version - Oracle Retrieve database version information from Oracle.
8 Querying Database Version - MySQL and Microsoft Retrieve database version information from MySQL and Microsoft SQL Server.
9 Listing Database Contents - Non-Oracle Enumerate tables and columns in non-Oracle databases.
10 Listing Database Contents - Oracle Enumerate tables and columns in Oracle databases.

Blind SQL Injection

# Lab Description
11 Conditional Responses Identify blind SQL Injection using conditional responses.
12 Conditional Errors Extract information using conditional database errors.
13 Time Delays Detect blind SQL Injection using time delays.
14 Time Delays and Information Retrieval Retrieve information using time-based SQL Injection.
15 Out-of-Band Interaction Detect SQL Injection through out-of-band interactions.
16 Out-of-Band Data Exfiltration Extract data using out-of-band SQL Injection techniques.

4. SQLMap

Learn automated SQL Injection detection and exploitation using SQLMap.

Resource Description

5. Bug Bounty Writeups
